starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Not often we get one like you 'round these parts. Wind push you ashore?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Apologies, not much one for the formalities. Name's Cormac. I'm the mayor of this place.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.player: Likewise. So what's with the others around here? Getting a sense they're not fans of... well, anyone.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Oh, pay 'em no mind. They're just a little wary of outsiders. Tend not t' get many through here, what with the isolated location and all.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.player: I'd expect more curiosity if outsiders are uncommon, if I'm honest...

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Our history's a complicated one... As I say, best put it out ya mind. That said, if you be wantin' to get in their good books, you could make yourself useful.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Well, if you're feeling brave, we've had one of the villagers, Keenan, go missing. We know he's not much of a sailor, so he'll be somewhere on the island.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.player: Couldn't you find him yourselves? The island doesn't seem like too much ground to cover.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Aye, we've tried, but this island... she has more than a few secrets... Were things different...

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.text: Ah, don't be worrying yourself about it. The point is, an outsider like yourself might be endin' up having better luck than we've had, if you're willing to help?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac.prompt: Start the Fallen From Grace quest?

steps.player: Alright, I'll help you find Keenan. Any ideas on where to start?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: I'd check in with his mother, Muriel. She'd know more than most. Their house is the one just t' north east of here.

steps.player: I'll head over there right away.
Actually, I've got something I need to do right now. Sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: That's okay. I'll still be here if you end up feelin' otherwise.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-a-s.player: You said there might be a way for me to get in people's good books?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-aft.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-aft.text: Any luck on your hunt for Keenan yet?

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-aft.speaker: Cormac
starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-aft.text: I'd start by checking in with his mother, Muriel. She'd know more than most. Their house is the one just t' north east of here.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-cormac-aft.player: I'll head over there right away.

starting-the-quest-trying-to-dock-in-the.text: You can't see any good reason to try to dock in this dangerous looking cavern.

starting-the-quest-trying-to-disembark-i.text: You can't see any good reason to try to disembark in this dangerous looking cavern.

talking-to-the-villagers-oisin.speaker: Oisin
talking-to-the-villagers-oisin.text: Always knew he'd get into trouble.

talking-to-the-villagers-oisin.player: Was he that kind of person?

talking-to-the-villagers-oisin.speaker: Oisin
talking-to-the-villagers-oisin.text: A troublemaker? No, not necessarily. Had a habit of being in his own world a lot, wandering about unaware of a lot of things. Not a lick of survival instinct in him.

talking-to-the-villagers-angus.speaker: Angus
talking-to-the-villagers-angus.text: You'll go the way of the last one: wyrm food.

talking-to-the-villagers-baldwin.speaker: Baldwin
talking-to-the-villagers-baldwin.text: Well, you won't find him. No one who disappears on this island ever shows up again.

talking-to-the-villagers-baldwin.speaker: Baldwin
talking-to-the-villagers-baldwin.text: None of your business. You'd be better off staying out of things. Now go away.

talking-to-the-villagers-catriona.player: Hello to you as well. I was wondering if you knew anything about Keenan's disappearance?

talking-to-the-villagers-rian.speaker: Rian
talking-to-the-villagers-rian.text: Outsider, you better not be causing trouble.

talking-to-the-villagers-rian.speaker: Rian
talking-to-the-villagers-rian.text: Heh. Makes you better than the last one then. Keep that up.

talking-to-the-villagers-rian.player: What did the last one do?

talking-to-the-villagers-rian.speaker: Rian
talking-to-the-villagers-rian.text: Acted up a storm about how their boat had been wrecked on the rocks and they needed help, only to then go and get themselves killed in the caverns after we'd patched them up.

talking-to-the-villagers-rian.speaker: Rian
talking-to-the-villagers-rian.text: A damn shame to waste what limited resources we have.

talking-to-the-villagers-ffion.player: Excuse me, you didn't happen to know Keenan did you?

talking-to-the-villagers-ffion.speaker: Ffion
talking-to-the-villagers-ffion.text: Sure did. Strange lad that one. Spent hours going on about sun energy, or something like that.

talking-to-the-villagers-ffion.speaker: Ffion
talking-to-the-villagers-ffion.text: That's right, though I must admit, I didn't fully pay attention, so I may have misunderstood.

options.text: What am I meant to be doing here?
I'm looking for Keenan. You haven't seen him, have you?

steps.player: I'm looking for Keenan. You haven't seen him, have you?

steps.speaker: Geoff
steps.text: Aye, I heard t'lad went missin', but I can nay tell ye if he's been 'ere or not. These bleedin' goats be far too distractin'.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.text: Ah... the outsider. I'm sorry, but I'm not really in the mood for visitors.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.player: I understand, but I'm actually here in the hopes that I can help you. Cormac has asked me to look for your son.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.text: Oh... well, what do you need from me?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.player: Did Keenan give you any idea where he might be going?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.text: No, no. It was a usual day. He ran about town doing everything he needed, then he grabbed his hat and went to sit and stare at the sunstone. I could never convince him to do something more productive...

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.text: That big rock over in the mine. He's been obsessed with it. Always going on about how it has some secret to be discovered...

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel.player: I see. I'll go over there and see if I can find anything of note.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.text: You're back. Have you had any luck finding Keenan?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.player: Not yet. Where did you say I should be looking?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.text: The sunstone over in the mine. He's been obsessed with it. Always going on about how it has some secret to be discovered...

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.player: Alright, I'll head over there and see what I can find.

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.text: Any luck on your hunt for Keenan yet?

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.player: Not yet, no, but Muriel's given me something to go on. I'll see if it leads me anywhere.

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.text: Let's hope it does. There be something out there that gives us a clue, I'm sure of it.

following-the-trail-inspecting-the-sunst.text: You look upon the large rock and feel a strange energy pulsing around you. You then notice a book amidst some nearby rocks, which you take. You also notice a trail of dust leading away from the rock...
If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You look upon the large rock and feel a strange energy pulsing around you. As you look upon it, you notice a book amidst some nearby rocks. However, you don't have enough room to take it.

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.text: Any luck on your hunt for Keenan yet?

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.player: I've found what I'm guessing is his notebook over in the mine.
I wouldn't call it all nonsense. He apparently felt like he was being watched whilst he was at the sunstone. That's something.

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.text: Watched? I mean, none of us really kept too close an eye on the lad. Why would he feel like someone was watching him?

following-the-trail-talking-to-cormac-af.player: Well, if I keep following the trail, maybe I'll find out.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.text: You're back. Have you had any luck finding Keenan?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.player: Not yet, but I've found a trail over in the mine that might lead me somewhere. Speaking of which, I'd better get back to it.

following-the-trail-investigating-the-la.text: You find a hat hooked onto a rock in the shadow of a large cathedral... Could the hat be Keenan's?
The camera slowly pans from the hat to the cathedral.
The hat appears to be hooked onto a rock. Could it be Keenan's?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.player: Does Keenan have a habit of losing his hat?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.text: Not particularly, no. He always takes good care of it. Why do you ask?

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.player: I found a hat caught up on some rocks to the south. I wondered if it might have been his.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.speaker: Muriel
following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-af.text: No, he'd not just leave it there like that. At least, not of his own volition...
Muriel begins to sob, preventing any further questioning.

following-the-trail-talking-to-muriel-ag.text: Muriel seems too upset to talk to you right now.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: Well, I found a hat that might belong to Keenan.
Down amongst the rocks beneath that big cathedral.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: The cathedral? No... No that can't be right...

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: What do you mean? What is that cathedral?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Ardeaglais. It be the home of the Mad Angel.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: I get the feeling you haven't been totally honest with me.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: It wasn't my wish to mislead, I just did nay want to waste your time with local superstitions...

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: It sounds like we might be dealing with more than superstitions.
I think it's time you explained. What is this Mad Angel?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Old. Vicious. At least, that's what some of the stories say. Others though... they call her our protector. The only thing keepin' us safe from horrors o' the deep sea.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: No. The stories... they be sayin' that she'll keep us safe in exchange for tribute, but if we fail to keep her happy, she'll take one o' ours instead.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: And you didn't think to mention this earlier?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: I thought they was just tales! That the cathedral was long abandoned! So many of the others get 'emselves proper worked up about the Angel, but my job is to keep things calm.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: Well, whatever the truth is, it seems I'm going to need to enter that cathedral. How do I get inside?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Well, I wouldn't even try the front... but maybe you'll have some luck getting in from beneath.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: The stories say that some o' the first settlers here apparently sailed into the caverns on the south side of the island, but between the rocks and the tides, their ships never be havin' a chance at coming back out.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Instead, they found another way t' get out, up onto the cliffs. The same one where they eventually built Ardeaglais.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: So I'm going to have to sail into those caverns myself?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Aye, but don't make the same mistake they did. Make sure t' use something on the smaller side, else you'll get into trouble on the rocks.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: And be careful down there. Some say the Mad Angel ain't the only danger on this island, and it ain't the wyrms they're talking about. They reckon there be other evils lurking in them caverns...

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: Wonderful. I'll be sure to take care then.

options.text: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?

steps.player: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: The tales say she led the first settlers here. She be the one to help 'em build this town and she kept them safe from all the dangers that come with such an out t' way location.

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: No. That happened slowly. To start with she was able t' live among the people, but eventually they had to build Ardeaglais for her.

steps.player: Which is where she's stayed ever since?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Supposedly. But no one's seen her in my lifetime, though I s'pose it's not like anyone be fancying going into Ardeaglais to check.

options.text: What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?

steps.player: What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Blood.

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Aye, a tithe of human blood. No other blood will do.

steps.player: And people here have still been doing that?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Well, a lot of us dismissed her as a myth, but there be plenty of superstitious folk here who were keen to make sure the tributes continued.

steps.player: So they just deliver some blood up to the cathedral?

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Pretty much. They leave it nearby and make sure not to be around when it gets taken.

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Aye, but hard to say if it's actually the Mad Angel doing it. Could be it's just the wildlife.

steps.speaker: Cormac
steps.text: Good luck, friend.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: Where was it you said I should go to get to the cathedral?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: You'll need to sail through the caverns that run beneath us. Should be able to get into them if you sail around to the south side of the island.

options.text: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?
What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-muri.text: Muriel seems too upset to talk to you right now.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.text: Hey you! Get over here, quickly!

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.text: It's dangerous here. What are you doing?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.player: A talking skeleton? What is this?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.text: That is a question that is not currently relevant, given our present situation. Help me with this blockage, and maybe then you'll get your answers.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.player: Fair enough... What do you need?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-meeting-mortime.text: It was those three nearby trolls that caused this, and they've not been happy about my attempts to sort it. Deal with them for me while I work on clearing the way.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: How are you doing with those trolls?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.player: I'm not quite done with them yet.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: Remember, I just need you to handle the three nearby ones.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-upon-killing-th.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-upon-killing-th.text: Hey! Come give me a hand over here.
You notice the skeleton calling you over.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: Perfect. I've pretty much got things cleared here. Give me a hand with the last few bits...
You help get the remaining rocks cleared...

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: Well, well, well, would you look at that! An adventurer who isn't just skin and bones! You did well handling those trolls.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.player: Thanks, but you look like you'd have been capable of handling them yourself.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: I would've done, if they hadn't trapped me on the other side of that rockfall.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.player: Fair point. So, who are you? And... what are you?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: The name's Mortimer, and I'm the oldest Slayer Master across all of the seas of Gielinor.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: Well noted. Now, what is it you're actually doing down here?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.player: I'm trying to find a missing villager. He may be up in the cathedral.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.speaker: Mortimer
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-mort.text: Hmm... a noble cause. I'm afraid I've not seen him myself. Good luck on your search though.

options.text: So you say you're a Slayer Master?

steps.player: So you say you're a Slayer Master?

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: Indeed. Perhaps you'd be up for one of my special slayer assignments?

steps.player: Maybe... What's so special about these assignments?

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: Well, back in my day there was a lot more freedom and less bureaucracy about what adventurers were assigned to slay... as long as it was in need of slaying.

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: If you slay for me, I will give you the choice of two different creatures to be assigned. If you continue to prove your worth to me, I could be convinced to offer three choices instead of two.

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: I'll only assign you options from creatures which have superior variants, regardless of whether you have that perk unlocked. My tasks also won't naturally offer any slayer points.

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: This is purely slaying for the love of slaying.

steps.speaker: Mortimer
steps.text: As an added bonus, some of my assignments include creatures which are more lucrative than they normally would be. I'll point this out when offering your assignments, so keep your eyes peeled.

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Any luck gettin' into the caverns?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: I've managed to get into them, yes. Still no sign of Keenan though.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Best we hope it isn't too late.

options.text: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?
What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-searching-the-g.text: It's a broken down golem made from sunstone. You begin to inspect it closer...
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.text: You find a dulled golem core within its chest, but you leave it behind as you have nowhere to put it.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-searching-the-g.text: If the player's inventory is not full:

steps.text: You find a dulled golem core within its chest.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-inspecting-the-.text: This sunstone core was presumably once used to power a golem, but it looks to be lifeless now.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-searching-the-g.text: It appears to be a broken down golem made from sunstone with a large hole in its chest. You might be able to get it to move if you can power it up.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-attempting-to-o.text: The door is firmly locked. If you want to enter the cathedral, you're going to need to find another way inside.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Any luck gettin' into the caverns?

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.player: I've managed to get into them, yes, but the way forward is blocked by some sort of golem. I think it's made of sunstone.

the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.speaker: Cormac
the-way-under-ardeaglais-talking-to-corm.text: Sunstone? I do nay know much about that stuff. Ironically, Keenan would 'ave been the best person t' ask. I remember Muriel sayin' he was fascinated by the stuff.

options.text: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?
What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?

entering-ardeaglais-putting-a-new-core-i.text: You place the sunstone core into the golem. It provides just enough energy for the golem to move aside, letting you get past it...

entering-ardeaglais-attempting-to-climb-.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You go to climb the stairs, but notice a locked hatch at the top of them.

entering-ardeaglais-attempting-to-climb-.text: You go to climb the stairs, but notice a locked hatch at the top of them. You also spot a note on the floor next to them.

entering-ardeaglais-reading-the-note-the.prompt: You notice something written on the back of the note...

entering-ardeaglais-reading-the-note-aga.prompt: Something is written on both the front and back of the note.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.text: Any luck gettin' into the caverns?

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.player: Yes, and I've found a way through them and into the basement of the cathedral. Still no sign of Keenan though.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.text: It's startin' to feel like we've taken t' long...

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-af.player: Well, we can't give up on him yet.

entering-ardeaglais-unlocking-the-chest.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You can see some interesting objects in the chest, but you have no space to take them.

entering-ardeaglais-unlocking-the-chest.text: You find a book and an old sunstone core in the chest.

entering-ardeaglais-searching-the-chest-.text: Searching the chest with a full inventory:
Searching the chest with one free inventory slot and neither items:

steps.text: You find an old sunstone core in the chest. You can see something else in it as well, but you have no space to take it.

entering-ardeaglais-searching-the-chest-.text: Searching the chest with the ancient sunstone core or staircase key but no golem primer:

steps.text: You find a book about golems in the chest.

entering-ardeaglais-searching-the-chest-.text: Searching the chest with the golem primer but no ancient sunstone core or staircase key:

steps.text: You find an old sunstone core in the chest.

entering-ardeaglais-searching-the-chest-.text: Searching the chest with both items already in inventory:

steps.text: There's nothing in the chest for you to take.

entering-ardeaglais-inpsecting-the-ancie.text: It's a very old sunstone core. It's long since run out of power, but as you inspect it, you hear something rattling within.

entering-ardeaglais-breaking-open-the-an.text: You break open the sunstone core and find a key hidden inside!

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-be.player: I've managed to find a way into the cathedral, but it's not looking good... Best I get back there right away.

entering-ardeaglais-inspecting-keenan-s-.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least. You spot a letter next to the body, but you don't have enough room to take it.

entering-ardeaglais-inspecting-keenan-s-.text: The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least. As you go to step away from the body, you spot a letter next to it...
The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least.

entering-ardeaglais-attempting-to-leave-.prompt: You attempt to open the doors, but they appear to be locked.

steps.text: The player successfully picks the lock:
You successfully pick the lock, only to see it crumble away in your hands.
The player fails to pick the lock:
Your fingers go numb from fiddling with the lock. You'll need to try again.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.player: Cormac, I was too late. I managed to enter the cathedral, but I found Keenan dead inside.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.text: I see... Well, I had been hopin' for better news, but I s'pose this was probably inevitable... Was there anything you could bring back? A body?

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.player: There was, but it's not something that Muriel should have to see.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.text: And the Angel? Did you deal with her?

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.player: She wasn't there. I think whatever was left of her mind felt guilt over Keenan's death. It seems she's left the island.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.text: Is that it? She just gets t' leave us fendin' for ourselves?

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.player: She's built a golem to replace herself. It put up quite the fight. It needs some battle hardening, but if you're worried for your security, I'm certain it'll be able to help.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.text: Well, in a day we've gone from wonderin' if the Mad Angel is even real, to learnin' she was, but that she's now gone an' left for good. I s'pose that makes it a new era for us 'ere.

entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.speaker: Cormac
entering-ardeaglais-talking-to-cormac-an.text: First up though, I'd best be tellin' Muriel the bad news. Until next time, [player name]... and I hope there will be a next time. Would be good for you t' stick around.
